exposure: Hematocrit in the first two hours (HCT2h) of life
cohort: The cohort consisted of 326 very preterm infants born at or earlier than 34 weeks gestational age.
finding: High hematocrit in the first two hours of life was identified as a significant protective factor against retinopathy of prematurity, showing a significant inverse association among preterm infants with a gestational age of 28 weeks or more.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not statistically significantly associated with the incidence of retinopathy of prematurity.
gest_age: Less than 34 weeks, with a subgroup analysis for 28 weeks or more
